claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the algorithm in proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied uniform nonidentity Q and uniform z (P = infinity exactly for z = 1) with success at least 0.39 (modelled lower bound 0.3917 - 2^-48), conditional on H1-H5 of source-core.md. It computes g=e(P0,Q), exactly uniform on GT minus {1} and independent of z, maps g and z into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of proof.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core (REVISION.md R1-R13: 99.9% ECM on theta=207/500, chunk scatter, 10.005 route, 20/entry transfers with 13/entry finishing and 22x4 blocks, exact prices, 0.05% reserve, refiltered N/U 0.0614, descent 850/2000, one-SE rels allowance, meter 118.48918, corrected loss proof, retention allowances, re-optimised plan, union allowances) and returns P=[a]P0 after checking e(P,Q)=z. Core ledger below 2^121.634559 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work (preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, field map, pairings, verification, output) is at most (2001/2000) x 2^121.634559 + 2^80/20000 < 2^121.635280167243655 units. Storage < 2^106 bytes; no advice/amortization. Analytic claim.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes every quantity changed by REVISION.md from the shipped code and data: region, count products, yield and margin, work SE and allowance, ECM schedules, the R3 route count (measurements12.txt R3 lines, STORAGE.md listing), the R4 finishing budget, linear algebra and generator, the descent recurrence, counter and repeat terms, success and the full ledger; then the recover-P total and success. Does not rerun unchanged inherited certificates.

Optional full recomputation of all inherited certificates (resultant, tower, rho, pool regeneration, filtering, retention, ECM toys, fields, alpha, audit) together with the revised model and declared bounds.

title: Recover P via the revised GT STNFS core with union-bounded allowances (R13): 121.635280167243655
